title: nmrflow: SMILES-based NMR/HRMS prediction
description: nmrflow predicts 1H/13C (and optional 19F/31P) NMR spectra, literature-style reported values, and HRMS m/z from a SMILES string. Outputs are predictions, not experimental data. Code: BSD-3-Clause. Bundled HOSE index: derivative of NMRShiftDB2 under the nmrshiftdb2 Database License.
